summary: Президент России Владимир Путин вспомнил о подвиге экипажа крейсера "Варяг", затопившего свой корабль в 1904 году.
Путин отметил, что моряки могли быть наказаны за ослушание приказа, но стали героями.
Эти события обсуждались во время визита Путина на гвардейский ракетный крейсер.

Кадры беседы показал журналист «Вестей» Павел Зарубин. Остановившись у картины, посвященной событию, Путин обратил внимание на то, что в Адмиралтействе долго решали, нарушили ли моряки приказ и должны ли они быть наказаны.…

stories.headline_en: Zimbabwe boat accident death toll hits 68 as 22 more bodies recovered
summary: В результате кораблекрушения на озере Кариба в Зимбабве погибли 68 человек, включая 18 детей.
Корабль перевернулся 15 августа 2026 года из-за перегрузки во время сильного ветра.
Спасатели продолжают поиски, и власти опасаются, что число жертв может возрасти.
На данный момент найдено 22 дополнительных тела, что увеличило общее число погибших до 80.

perspectives.headline: Zimbabwe boat accident death toll hits 68 as 22 more bodies recovered
perspectives.excerpt: Twenty-two more bodies have been recovered after a boat accident in Zimbabwe, taking the death toll to 68, police said on Saturday. The ferry capsized on Tuesday on Lake Kariba, on the border with Zambia. An investigation has suggested it was overloaded when it turned over during heavy winds. Eighteen children were among the people killed, Zimbabwe’s police said, in what is believed to be the country’s deadliest such disaster.…

perspectives.headline: More bodies found after ferry disaster in Zimbabwe as number of deaths climbs to 72
perspectives.excerpt: Twenty-six more bodies have been found after a ferry capsized in Zimbabwe - taking the total number of deaths to at least 72.

perspectives.headline: Death toll from Zimbabwe capsized ferry accident rises to 80
perspectives.excerpt: Rescue workers recovered eight more bodies on Sunday following a ferry capsizing accident that occured earlier this week on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe, bringing the death toll to at least 80. The search continues, as authorities fear the number of casualties could rise even further.

stories.headline: Четыре картины эпохи Ренессанса украдены из итальянского музея
stories.headline_en: Four 'extraordinary' Renaissance paintings stolen from Italian museum
summary: Четыре картины, приписываемые Антонелло да Мессина, были украдены из Регионального междисциплинарного музея Мессины в Сицилии.
Кража произошла в ночь на 15 августа 2026 года во время национального праздника Феррагосто.
Среди украденных произведений три панели Полиптиха Сан Грегорио и двусторонняя панель Мадонны с младенцем.
Министр культуры Италии подтвердил, что картины имеют «исключительную ценность».

perspectives.excerpt: Four of the most important works of art by the 15th-century Renaissance master Antonello da Messina were stolen during a national holiday from a museum in the Sicilian port city of Messina. Thieves gained access to the Regional Museum of Messina, or MuMe, on Saturday evening, possibly capitalising on attention being focused on La Vara, a huge religious festival that takes place in the city on 15 August, when Italy marks the Ferragosto national holiday.…

Lebanon's prime minister said seven people were killed in a strike on a house on the outskirts of Ansar, 70km (43 miles) south of the capital, Beirut. State media reported three children and two women were among the dead.…

The Lebanese Health Ministry said one of the strikes, on the edge of the village of Ansar, killed seven people and wounded two.…

perspectives.headline: South Lebanon: How will Israeli strikes affect negotiations?
perspectives.excerpt: Israel killed 11 people in strikes on southern Lebanon on Saturday, in what has been described as the biggest threat to the peace talks since the June agreement. Ziad Majed, Professor of Middle East Studies at the American University of Paris, spoke to FRANCE 24 about the potential impact of the strikes on the negotiations underway in Rome, the role of the United States, and Israel's policy towards Lebanon and especially Hezbollah.

stories.headline: Ураган Лала вызвал на Гавайях внезапные наводнения
stories.headline_en: Hurricane Lala sparks flash floods in Hawaii as strong winds and rain persist
summary: Ураган Лала, прошедший мимо Большого острова Гавайев, вызвал внезапные наводнения и оставил десятки тысяч домов без электричества.
Ураган достиг категории 1 и принес сильные дожди и ветры, создавая опасные условия, включая оползни.
Ожидается, что ураган станет первым возможным прямым ударом по Большому острову за 155 лет, хотя он не задел землю.
Власти призвали жителей оставаться в укрытиях из-за продолжающихся опасных условий.

perspectives.headline: Hurricane Lala sparks flash floods in Hawaii as strong winds and rain persist
perspectives.excerpt: Hawaii is facing flash floods that may have swept some homes away after category one Hurricane Lala skirted Big Island, as it continues to grapple with strong winds and torrential rain. Tens of thousands of properties have been left without power and officials have warned people to prepare for "life-threatening" conditions, including mudslides, as the storm continues moving westward to the south of Hawaii.…

perspectives.headline: US: Hurricane Lala brings Hawaii heavy rain, strong winds

The hurricane had earlier strengthened to Category 1 as its eye approached the southern part of Big Island. It was expected be the Big Island's first possible direct hit from a hurricane in 155 years but that was not to be as the storm passed the island's southern tip.…

perspectives.headline: US : Hawaii narrowly avoids direct hit as Hurricane Lala brings strong weather
perspectives.excerpt: Hawaii has narrowly avoided a historic direct hit from Hurricane Lala, but torrential rain and hurricane-force winds are still causing widespread flooding, mudslides and power outages across the islands. Authorities are urging residents to shelter in place as the storm moves west and dangerous conditions persist.

stories.headline: SpaceX официально завершила приобретение Cursor
stories.headline_en: SpaceX officially closes its Cursor acquisition
summary: AI-стартап Cursor стал частью SpaceX после завершения сделки на сумму 60 миллиардов долларов.
Сделка была анонсирована в апреле 2023 года, когда компании начали совместную работу по разработке технологий.
Cursor известен своим AI-инструментом для программирования и теперь имеет доступ к инфраструктуре SpaceX.
Сделка является одной из крупнейших в истории венчурного капитала.

perspectives.headline: SpaceX officially closes its Cursor acquisition
perspectives.excerpt: AI coding startup Cursor is now officially a part of SpaceX, according to an announcement on the Cursor blog. Elon Musk’s SpaceX — which also acquired Musk’s xAI earlier this year — announced a deal in April for the companies to develop technology together; the deal also gave SpaceX the option to acquire Cursor for $60 billion. Two months later, as SpaceX became a public company, the companies said they were moving forward with the acquisition.…

perspectives.headline: 2 charts: SpaceX closes $60B acquisition of Cursor
perspectives.excerpt: The second-largest acquisition of a venture-backed company on record is official. Cursor, the fast-growing agentic coding startup, is now a part of SpaceX after the space giant led by Elon Musk completed its $60 billion all-stock acquisition Friday. The deal pairs one of the fastest-growing startups with SpaceX's vast—and expensive to run—infrastructure-centric xAI division. The latter has its sights set on improving its AI service offerings and is betting big on agentic coding to get there.…

The companies announced the acquisition in June, but the process apparently started in April, when they teamed up for Cursor's model training efforts.…

stories.headline: Южная Корея предлагает переговоры для официального завершения войны с Северной
stories.headline_en: South Korea proposes talks to officially end war with North
summary: Президент Южной Кореи Ли Чжэ Мён предложил переговоры с Северной Кореей для официального завершения Корейской войны.
Предложение включает создание многоуровневой системы безопасности для предотвращения конфликтов на демилитаризованной зоне.
Корейская война продолжается более 70 лет из-за отсутствия мирного договора.
Переговоры были предложены 15 августа 2023 года.

perspectives.headline: South Korea proposes talks to officially end war with North
perspectives.excerpt: South Korea's president has proposed talks with its northern neighbour on officially ending the war between the two that is technically still active. Lee Jae Myung suggested a "multi-layered security system" to avoid flare-ups along the countries' de-facto border, known as the demilitarised zone (DMZ), and offered to discuss practical ways of halting Pyongyang's nuclear ambitions.…

perspectives.headline: South Korea president proposes talks with Pyongyang to formally end Korean War
perspectives.excerpt: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung proposed on Saturday that Pyongyang engage in dialogue to formally end the Korean War, which has technically been ongoing for more than 70 years due to the lack of a peace treaty.

stories.headline: Семья застряла в море на 16 часов после переворота гидроцикла в Таиланде
stories.headline_en: Family stranded at sea for 16 hours after jet ski capsized in Thailand
summary: Французская семья была спасена после того, как их арендованный гидроцикл перевернулся у побережья Таиланда, и они провели в море более 16 часов.
Спасены 50-летний отец и его двое сыновей, которым потребовалась медицинская помощь.
Все трое были в состоянии истощения после того, как проглотили много морской воды.
Спасение произошло у острова Ко Самуи.

perspectives.headline: Family stranded at sea for 16 hours after jet ski capsized in Thailand
perspectives.excerpt: A French family was left stranded at sea for more than 16 hours overnight after their rented jet ski capsized off the coast of Thailand. A 50-year-old father and his sons, five and seven, were left "pale" and "exhausted after swallowing a lot of seawater" before being rescued, local government official Amorn Chomchoey told AFP. All three were taken to hospital for checks but were discharged shortly afterwards, Chomchoey said.…

perspectives.headline: French father and two children rescued after 16 hours adrift off Thai island

summary: Сборная России завоевала две золотые и две серебряные медали на Международной олимпиаде по информатике в Ташкенте с 9 по 15 августа.
Золотые медали получили Максим Кравченко и Владислав Жиганов, который занял второе место среди всех участников.

stories.headline_en: Moroccan police arrest more than 100 people as they attempt to enter Ceuta
summary: Марокканская полиция арестовала 111 человек, пытавшихся пересечь границу в испанскую Сеуту.
Попытка пересечения произошла после массового наплыва мигрантов, когда более 72,000 человек попытались попасть в Сеуту, что вызвало напряженность в ЕС.
Полиция усилила охрану границ после распространения ложной информации в соцсетях о открытии границы.

perspectives.headline: Moroccan police arrest more than 100 people as they attempt to enter Ceuta
perspectives.excerpt: Moroccan police have arrested 111 people as they tried to enter Spain’s north African territory of Ceuta, amid tightened security on both sides after social media posts called for another mass crossing. The attempted crossing on Saturday came two weeks after more than 72,000 migrants surged into Ceuta, causing tensions within the EU and prompting anti-immigration rhetoric among far-right parties worldwide. At least 96 people died trying to reach European soil.…

perspectives.headline: Ceuta: False social media posts fuel migration tensions
perspectives.excerpt: False social media posts claiming the Morocco-Ceuta border would open for Spain’s Assumption holiday have prompted migrants to gather near the crossing. Moroccan and Spanish authorities have tightened security after a recent mass influx into Ceuta, while Morocco says those spreading the false claims could face legal action.
